cohort: Women delivering at a tertiary centre after term prelabour rupture of membranes with an unfavourable cervix and managed expectantly for at least 2 days.
finding: In women with term PROM and an unfavourable cervix, spontaneous labour occurred in almost half of those undelivered after 2 days of expectant management, with younger maternal age and higher Bishop score at day 2 associated with spontaneous labour.
